future_scaling.description: Notes on scaling Mandala bot from 2 to 100+ gardeners. Architecture decisions, cost estimates, and technical roadmap for when growth demands it.

current_state.hosting: Render (free tier, 512MB RAM, auto-sleep after 15min idle)

rate_limits.qwen_flash_alibaba: 20 requests/min, 200 requests/day (Alibaba Cloud provider limit through OpenRouter)
rate_limits.current_status: Fallback handles occasional rate limits. Not critical at 2 gardeners.

scaling_milestones.action: Request queue (Redis/RabbitMQ) between bot and LLM. Rate limiter: max 20 req/min per model. Priority: paying gardeners first.

Model pool: primary Qwen Flash (Alibaba) → fallback Qwen Plus → fallback Groq (Llama 4, free 14K req/day) → fallback Gemini Flash (free 1500 req/day). Simple intents ('show tasks') routed to code without LLM.

Self-hosted vLLM server. Rent GPU instance (RTX 4090, 24GB VRAM), deploy Qwen 3.5 Flash quantized (Q4_K_M, 22GB). OpenAI-compatible API — drop-in replacement for OpenRouter URL. Unlimited requests, fixed cost.

self_hosted_llm.description: Replace OpenRouter with self-hosted vLLM inference server. Same model (Qwen 3.5 Flash), same quality, zero rate limits.

model_size.for_mac_m3: 5.5 GB (runs on MacBook M3 Max 48GB RAM)

hardware_requirements.entry_gpu: NVIDIA RTX 4090 (24 GB VRAM) — $0.50-0.80/hr cloud, $30-50/mo reserved
hardware_requirements.note: Single RTX 4090 handles 100+ simultaneous gardeners with continuous batching (vLLM PagedAttention)

performance.vllm_throughput: 2-4x faster than standard inference due to PagedAttention
performance.ttft_improvement: 2-5x faster time-to-first-token vs OpenRouter (no network hop to Alibaba Cloud)
performance.continuous_batching: Allows dynamic request insertion — new gardener messages added to current GPU batch instantly

setup_steps: 1. Rent GPU server with RTX 4090 (Spheron/Lambda Labs)
5. Bot code unchanged — vLLM is OpenAI-compatible
preserves: Same model weights → same knowledge, languages, reasoning quality
Same SR_SYSTEM_PROMPT → same Mandala personality, values, communication style
Same OpenAI-compatible API format → zero code changes in bot.py
does_not_preserve: OpenRouter's built-in caching (can add Redis caching locally)
OpenRouter's automatic provider fallback (can implement multi-model pool instead)

architecture_evolution.v8.0: Telegram → Render (bot.py) → Redis Queue → Model Pool (Qwen/Groq/Gemini) → GitHub (storage)
architecture_evolution.v8.5: Telegram → Render (bot.py) → Self-hosted vLLM (GPU server) → GitHub (storage). Option: move bot.py to same GPU server, remove Render entirely.
